# Book club

We meet on the last Thursday of every month at 19:30, taking turns at members'
homes. The host provides drinks; everyone else brings a small snack. The
schedule for the year is in the shared calendar.

The book for November is "The Remains of the Day" by Kazuo Ishiguro. Read up to
the end of the second day for the first meeting; the rest is for December.
Martin leads the discussion and sends three questions in advance.

New members can join after attending two meetings as guests. The club is
limited to twelve people so that everyone gets to speak. Whoever misses three
meetings in a row without saying so gives up the place to the waiting list.
